def compress_sentence(n, words):
    result = words[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        word = words[i]
        max_overlap = 0
        for j in range(1, min(len(result), len(word)) + 1):
            if result[-j:] == word[:j]:
                max_overlap = j
        result += word[max_overlap:]
    return result

n = int(input().strip())
words = input().strip().split()
print(compress_sentence(n, words))
